title: CELLSTYLEMAP low-level DXF wire writer
mode: ODA and LibreDWG schema cross-check plus generated ASCII/Binary DXF writer tests

authoritativeReferences.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authoritativeReferences.finding: The specification defines CELLSTYLEMAP cell-style identity and content fields, plus its TABLESTYLE extension-dictionary relationship through ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_2008_TABLESTYLE_CELLSTYLEMAP.

authoritativeReferences.title: LibreDWG DXF marker mapping and importer
authoritativeReferences.finding: Peer schema maps CELLSTYLE, TABLEFORMAT_BEGIN, CONTENTFORMAT, margin/grid format boundaries, and CELLSTYLE identity markers to concrete DXF group codes. This is comparator evidence for the marker spelling/order, not native CAD acceptance.

researchConclusion.resolved: A bounded low-level writer can emit the documented CELLSTYLEMAP object body and the cross-implementation marker mapping in ASCII and Binary DXF, including versioned style-ID checks and optional-reference remapping.
researchConclusion.unresolved: The complete emitted object graph is not implemented: source-to-emitted identity closure, the TABLESTYLE extension-dictionary edge, NOD/root reachability, and independent-reader semantic acceptance remain unqualified. The concrete adapter must continue refusing all captured CELLSTYLEMAP objects before publication.

changes: Added dxfRW::writeCellStyleMap as a low-level object-body writer with validation for versioned style identities, enum/flag domains, finite numeric values, safe strings, CMC data, border slots, and optional references.
Emitted CELLSTYLEMAP and AcDbCellStyleMap framing plus cell-style, content, margin, grid, color, value, and identity/name marker groups.
Resolved optional text-style and linetype handles through the active writer remap; zero NoHandle values remain null optional references.

Added generated ASCII/Binary tests for ordered marker sequences, representative values, true-color CMC strings, remapped references, zero-edge border slots, and AC1021 refusal/retry for R24 built-in style ID 4.
Registered a focused fast CTest. No persistent test drawing was added.
